item.title: Assembly
item.description:
Enclosure Options

The PCB (92 × 99.5mm) fits both Hammond 1455 enclosure variants, held by a 3D-printed internal frame. PCB and HDD sit side-by-side, SATA connector direct-mates between them.

Slim — Hammond 1455L2201

220 × 103 × 30.5 mm, 2.5" HDD only.

Wide — Hammond 1455T2601

260 × 160 × 51.5 mm, 2.5" or 3.5" HDD.

Cutouts Required

  • Barrel jack or screw terminal (12V DC input)
  • RJ45 (Ethernet)
  • USB-C
  • Tactile button (recessed)
  • RGB LED (light pipe or translucent window)

item.title: Design Notes
item.description:
See hardware/DESIGN.md for detailed circuit design notes, PCB routing guidelines, and netclass definitions.

Key Design Decisions

  • ASM1061 over USB-to-SATA bridges: Native PCIe SATA controller using the standard Linux ahci driver. No proprietary firmware blob required.
  • 12V DC input: Required for 3.5" HDD support. AP64501SP-13 accepts 3.8–28V.
  • SATA power control: 12V and 5V to SATA connector are software-controlled via GPIO5. HDD is off by default at boot.
  • USB-C OTG: For eMMC flashing (rpiboot) and USB mass storage gadget mode.
  • Boot strategy: Full OS on CM4 eMMC, SATA HDD dedicated to LUKS-encrypted backup storage only.
